Name: Stone Building Mod
Author: SeraphineDreams
Description:
[b]IMPORTANT NOTE! Delete the old config file before loading the new version, the old config file will break the mod. Thank you to pitytheviolins for finding the issue!
Also, the broken house mod needs to be enabled in the config in the main menu before loading your save or the smoke for houses 1 and 2 will be in the wrong place!
[/b]
[u]6.2.0[/u]

Sorry for the long wait, I will never promise a quick update again because doing so will make fate go "hold my beer". Lesson learned. Stone cabins are done, Sheds next! Added an icy fish pond option for winters

I have so much planned for the future for the other buildings, but I think for now the houses are done. Requested fish ponds are next, followed by cabins because I realized I need to destroy them to match the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17466]Broken Farmhouse mod by Glymr[/url], which I absolutely adore and will probably never play without again (more explanation at the bottom as to why).

Unfortunately, most of the buildings still have limited options, I am working on them as well, I promise. I also have a really cool second mod that I am currently working on that I think people will like. More on that later! Anyways, I need to go sleep, so please enjoy and let me know if you find any rogue pixels I need to fix!

I also made a [url=https://ko-fi.com/seraphinedreams]Ko-fi[/url] page! Nothing is ever expected but anything is always appreciated! 




[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17466]Broken Farmhouse mod by Glymr[/url] and why it is a personal must have mod:

This mod lets you play out a really cool DIY fantasy where the farmhouse has broken down after being abandoned for so long. The only thing that drove me nuts was that the house still started off small on the outside and got bigger as it upgraded, which made no sense. Not that it changed anything gameplay wise, but it bugged me. So one of the first things I did was modify the houses I was currently using in my game to start off broken down and repair slowly as the house leveled up. So house 1 is completely destroyed, house 2 has a fixed bottom floor and destroyed upper floor, and house 3 is completely repaired.

Now that I'm updating this mod again, I decided I absolutely wanted to include a broken down version to match Glymr's mod. I have also discovered that taking pretty houses in game and absolutely wrecking them is way more fun than it has any right to be.

I may end up doing a similar thing with coops and barns to go with the meadowlands farm or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37930]juanpa98r's Starter Buildings[/url] mod as well so you can start off with an old destroyed coop or barn on the farm and as it upgrades it gets repaired if there's any interest there. Or if I decide to start over with a new game. Again.
